correctStatements.text: At 22:50 facilities-oncall-gauteng reported that cooling unit CRAC-2 in hall B tripped and inlet temperature was 31 C and rising.
Thabo.Mokoena said hall B draws 180 kW, more than CRAC-1 alone can handle.
At 22:57 elena_petrova started draining non-critical workloads from hall B.
At 23:02 j.whitfield ordered portable chillers with an ETA of 90 minutes.
facilities-oncall-gauteng traced the tripped breaker to a failed compressor contactor.
At 23:15 elena_petrova powered down the batch cluster, switching off 140 servers.
At 23:21 Thabo.Mokoena saw inlet temperature peak at 34 C and start falling.
At 23:36 facilities-oncall-gauteng replaced the contactor and restarted CRAC-2.
At 23:48 Thabo.Mokoena confirmed the temperature was back at 24 C.
At 00:06 elena_petrova began bringing batch servers back in groups of 20.
j.whitfield said no customer-facing services were interrupted, only internal batch jobs.
Action item: stock a spare contactor on site, owner facilities-oncall-gauteng.
Action item: add temperature alerts at 28 C, owner j.whitfield.
